subject: Data for parametric and cat coverage — a source-labelled fire and heat season
body:
Hi,

I'm writing from Talaix (talaix.com), a climate-extreme intelligence platform built on satellite Earth observation and open data — every figure labelled with its source and evidence status.

This season underlines why trigger design needs traceable data: Copernicus reported on 12 August the hottest June–July on record for western Europe with record-low soil moisture, and wildfires in north-eastern Algeria killed at least 12 people amid extreme heat and drought (Al Jazeera, 29 Aug).

For parametric and catastrophe-reinsurance coverage, Talaix can prepare hazard screening and exposure counts — per asset or portfolio — with the provenance of every input stated.

Happy to send a short data brief.

Best,
Motaz OMARIEN. Talaix
Earth Observation & Environmental Risk
Financial Decision Intelligence

subject: ILS and cat bonds — exposure evidence from open Earth-observation data
body:
Hi Steve,

I'm writing from Talaix (talaix.com), a climate-extreme intelligence platform working from satellite Earth observation, reanalysis and official open data.

For ILS and cat-bond analysis, the binding constraint is rarely the hazard model — it is verifiable exposure evidence. Talaix screens assets against seven hazards from open data, and every output carries its source and evidence class, so an observed value is never confused with a modelled one.

If useful for an Artemis piece, we can prepare a worked example — wildfire or flood exposure for a defined set of assets — with uncertainty stated.

subject: Satellite data for insurance and finance workflows — closing the provenance gap
body:
Hi,

For Via Satellite's industry coverage: one persistent gap between satellite data and its use in insurance and finance is provenance — financial users often cannot tell an observed measurement from a modelled estimate.

Talaix (talaix.com), a climate-extreme intelligence platform built on Earth observation and open data, addresses this by attaching an evidence class to every output, from hazard screening to exposure counts.
